step_by_step_reasoning: The whiteboard shows a serverless and containerized architecture for Enoptea. On the left, traffic enters via Elastic Load Balancing (ELB) to Elastic Beanstalk (EC2-based frontend/backend), which reads directly from an RDS database. Beanstalk also triggers API Gateway. API Gateway routes requests to three Lambda functions (written in PHP via custom runtime/layers). The top Lambda retrieves PDF invoices from external providers, places them in an S3 bucket, which triggers SQS queues. SQS queues invoke the middle and bottom Lambda functions for asynchronous invoice processing and analysis. The middle and bottom Lambdas store results in ElastiCache (cache/temporary data) and RDS (primary database).
